name: Somchai Chaiyong
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for tinkering with engines, initially fueled by helping his uncle repair scooters in their small village. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering at Chulalongkorn University, where he specialized in automotive design. After graduating, Somchai joined a local racing team, quickly proving his aptitude for race engineering. His calm demeanor and meticulous approach to data analysis allowed him to optimize car performance under pressure.

His engineering philosophy revolves around incremental improvements and data-driven decisions. Somchai prefers a systematic approach, meticulously analyzing telemetry to identify areas for optimization. While some might consider him cautious, his pragmatic approach has consistently delivered reliable and competitive results. He joined Vee Masters five years ago, looking for a new challenge and the opportunity to work with cutting-edge racing technology. He is known for his ability to explain complex engineering concepts in a simple way to the driver.

What sets Somchai apart is his ability to blend technical expertise with a deep understanding of driver psychology. He recognizes that a car's performance is only as good as the driver's confidence in it, and he is adept at building strong working relationships to achieve maximum performance on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: A man of medium build, Somchai often sports a focused expression behind his wire-rimmed glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten engineering notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking only jasmine tea during race weekends.
